projects.title: For a  Just World
projects.description:
The Council of Europe is the leading organisation for human rights in the continent. They requested from Karrota writing and illustrating two comic books in Albanian, English, and Serbian languages.

The mission of this project was to raise awareness among children and adults about human trafficking and the ways to report trafficking cases.

The comic book "2 Minutes" addresses child abuse and exploitation by individuals involved in criminal gangs.

Meanwhile, "Dream" tells the story of a girl who finds an online scholarship announcement, which turns out to be fake, and she ends up in the hand…
